blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Eight cheerdance squads are set to take center stage on Saturday for the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition at Mall of Asia Arena. UST Salinggawi Dance Troupe will open the competition, looking to end an 11-year championship drought, while National University Pep Squad aims to extend its reign after winning back-to-back titles. READ: NU Pep Squad had familiar help en route to UAAP Cheerdance win UP Pep Squad will perform second, followed by UE Pep Squad, Adamson Pep Squad, DLSU Animo Squad and Ateneo Blue Eagles.
